A Cappella Club

A Cappella Club

We are the ideal place for singers of all backgrounds who are looking to sharpen their musical skills, perform the songs that they love, and make amazing new friends as a part of the biggest and best musical community at BYU! Our mission is to inspire and uplift BYU by sharing our musical talents and cultivating a Spirit-centered environment where passionate musicians can thrive. Participating in one of the 11 different groups in the A Cappella Club will give students a place where they can sing, dance, express, and create like no where else on campus. In addition to performing, we also provide host of exciting opportunities to lead, direct, compose, arrange, record, choreograph, and serve! So whether your only music experience is singing hymns at church, or you're getting ready to audition for Vocal Point and Noteworthy, there is a place in the A Cappella Club for YOU! So what are you waiting for?!? 2024 GENERAL AUDITIONS for the Club will be Tuesday September 10th from 7:30-9:00pm in the Varsity Theatre (WSC) and again in the first week of the winter semester. Be sure to follow us on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube at @byuacappella for important updates and feel free to reach out to acappellaclub@byu.edu for questions or more information!
